json_patch.value: Fix: feat: native Ace chat model and five branded service toolkits. Target files: .github/workflows/ci.yaml, .gitignore, AGENTS.md. Developers can import `ChatAceDataCloud` without supplying a custom Base URL, and independently install Suno, Seedance, HappyHorse, GPT Image or Nano Banana by Ace Data Cloud as LangChain-native tool packages. One source repository shares HTTP/task behavior while preserving six package identities, five typed service contracts, branded guides/icons and official-listing materials. (Ref: https://github.com/AceDataCloud/LangChain/pull/1)
